plainName: Incomes not included in total income
summary: Some incomes are left out of your total income when the conditions set for them are met: among those built, parts of house rent allowance and leave travel help, certain special allowances, and parts of what you receive on retirement or leaving a job. Where a condition is not met, the income is taxed. Some of them, house rent allowance among them, are not available in the default regime.

routes.name: House rent allowance
routes.description: The part the rules exempt for rent you pay.

routes.name: Leave travel help
routes.description: The part the rules exempt for journeys within India.

routes.name: Special allowances
routes.description: The parts the rules exempt for uniform, conveyance, children's education and hostel, and transport for a disabled employee.

routes.name: Retirement and leaving a job
routes.description: The parts exempt of gratuity, commuted pension, leave encashment, retrenchment compensation and voluntary retirement.

disqualifiers.description: House rent allowance is not exempt in the default regime.
The other incomes the schedules leave out, and the persons wholly exempt, are not computed.
